# Kept: the 124 US metro areas for which the atlas has, or has had, its own pay and rent figures. One line per metro: "c" and the
# Census CBSA code (the file's AREA column), then the annual mean wage (A_MEAN) of each kind of work per 1,000 of the
# metro's all-occupations mean (OCC_CODE 00-0000):
#   a = 35-0000 food preparation and serving        b = 41-2031 retail salespersons
#   c = 47-0000 construction and extraction + 49-0000 installation, maintenance and repair, weighted by employment
#   d = 53-0000 transportation and material moving  e = 51-0000 production
#   f = 37-0000 building and grounds cleaning       g = 39-0000 personal care and service
#   h = 31-0000 healthcare support                  i = 29-0000 healthcare practitioners and technical
#   j = 25-0000 educational instruction and library l = 43-0000 office and administrative support
#   m = 15-0000 computer and mathematical + 17-0000 architecture and engineering, weighted by employment
#   n = 13-0000 business and financial operations   o = 27-0000 arts, design, entertainment, sports and media
#   p = 19-0000 life, physical and social science   q = 45-0000 farming, fishing and forestry
#   r = 33-0000 protective service
# k = the seventeen values added up, modulo 97 (a check on copying).
